notes.title: Updates made before release
notes.notes:
Hello there fellow players!
Here we are with a quick update, regarding the changes we are making before releasing the game.
We integrated the game with Steam, leaving PlayFab, on which we have relied since we started thinking about the game. Now all data and statistics are managed by the Steam platform.
We also added a nice number of Achievements (currently 32) that will reward the player during his progress, from the advancement in the various arenas, through the calculation of miles covered, destroyed buildings, shots fired, up to the counting of multiplayer games (let's say that there are for all tastes).
We look forward to releasing the title and be able to challenge you in the arenas!
